Name: Polaris
Description: Keys and dials for your Polaris: send a message, set your status, mute or hang up your call, play a sound, see unread messages, alarms and deployments, and switch the devices in your places.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.key.Name: Action
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.key.Tooltip: Runs a Polaris action or shows its live state.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.dial.Name: Device dial
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.dial.Tooltip: Adjusts a Polaris device, such as a light's brightness.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.timer.Name: Timer
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.timer.Tooltip: A countdown or stopwatch. Press to start or pause, hold to reset.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.call.Name: Call
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.call.Tooltip: Mute, deafen, camera, record or hang up the call you are on in Polaris.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.sound.Name: Soundboard
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.sound.Tooltip: Plays one of your sounds into the call you are on.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.places.Name: Places device
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.places.Tooltip: A device of your places on its own key: shows it, and switches, opens or locks it.

io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.places-dial.Name: Places dial
io.github.fjrg2007.polaris.places-dial.Tooltip: Sets a light's brightness or an air conditioner's temperature.
